% Error bars: explicit symmetric and asymmetric values from coordinates,
% a table error column, fixed relative errors in x; error ends extend
% the limits. Behaviour X2.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}
  \addplot+[error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit] coordinates {(1,2) +- (0,0.5) (2,3) +- (0,1) (3,1.5) += (0,0.5) -= (0,0.25)};
  \addplot+[error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit] table [x=a, y=b, y error=e] {
    a b e
    1.3 1 0.25
    2.3 1.5 0.5
    3.3 0.5 0.2
  };
  \addplot+[only marks, error bars/.cd, x dir=both, x fixed relative=0.1] coordinates {(1.5,2.5) (2.5,3.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
